name: 81144 · Monte Vista, CO
findings: ZIP 81144 (Monte Vista) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81144 (Monte Vista) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81144 (Monte Vista) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
